name: Essex Property Trust

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Essex Property Trust logo.svg)

description: Essex owns apartment communities only on the US West Coast. At Dec 31, 2025 it owned or had interests in 259 operating communities with 63,077 apartment homes: 26,265 in Southern California, 24,154 in Northern California and 12,658 in the Seattle area. Apartments produced 99.2% of 2025 revenue, almost all of it monthly rent plus a small amount of fees from affiliated joint ventures. Growth comes from rent increases in supply-constrained coastal cities, acquisitions and a small development pipeline (one consolidated project of 543 homes).
